introHtml: Copper pocket utility knives offer a distinctive look that sets them apart from standard steel or aluminum options. The natural patina that develops over time gives each knife a unique character, making them memorable promotional items for clients or employees. Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts or tradespeople, these knives can be laser engraved with your logo for a high-end finish. Choose copper for a gift that stands out and gets used daily.
